rca_of_the_issue: Previous iteration_20 defect: fxOf used regex like /text-shadow:\s*(?!none)[^;"']/i where \s* before the negative lookahead could backtrack to zero width and bypass the lookahead. Fixed by rewriting fxOf to explicitly extract the value via styleVal(html,prop) using /prop\s*:\s*([^;"']+)/i and then comparing against the meaningful predicate (ts!=='none', parseFloat(stroke)>0, clip==='text', anim.includes('wdtfx_')). This avoids lookahead-backtracking altogether and correctly returns text:false for the cleared style string. Verified in the live UI.
